question: Could your phone run your coding agent?

hook_visual.intent: the agent running on a phone, and the same agent driven on a laptop

points.claim: DSH Go is an Android client for DeepSeek Harness that runs the harness on the phone or drives the one on a computer.
points.spoken: It's DSH Go, an Android app for DeepSeek Harness: it runs the harness on your phone, or drives the one on your computer.
points.source_note: README (English): 'An Android client for DeepSeek Harness. Run DSH right on your phone, or drive the one on your computer.'

visual.intent: an app that holds the harness and reaches the desktop one

points.title: The harness, on Android
points.sub: Or drive the one on your computer.

points.claim: It installs Ubuntu, Node.js and DSH from inside the app, without root and without a separate Termux install.
points.spoken: It installs Ubuntu, Node and the harness inside the app, with no root and no Termux.
points.source_note: README Features: 'On-device runtime: install Ubuntu, Node.js and DSH from the app without Root or a separate Termux installation.'

visual.intent: the runtime being installed inside the app

points.title: Linux inside the app

points.claim: You can send a message while it is replying, answer tool approvals, and finished steps fold into one line.
points.spoken: You can answer tool approvals, send a message while it's replying, and finished steps fold into one line.
points.source_note: README: 'Chime in, interrupt, stay tidy: Send a message while DSH is replying'; 'Finished steps fold into one line.'; Features: 'respond to tool approvals and questions'.

visual.intent: the chat where you approve, interrupt, and steps fold away

points.title: A chat that keeps up

points.claim: After permissions, the local engine reads the screen, taps and types, and sensitive actions stay with you by default.
points.spoken: With permissions it reads the screen and taps for you, and sensitive actions stay with you by default.
points.source_note: README Features: 'Phone control: after you enable the required permissions, let the local engine read the screen, tap and type. You can stop it at any time.'; 'Sensitive actions stay with you by default'.

visual.intent: the engine tapping a screen while sensitive steps wait for you

points.title: It can tap for you
points.sub: Sensitive actions still wait for you.

catch: The catch: it's Android only for now, and remote mode takes images only, not the whole web interface.
catch_sub: Android now; iOS and HarmonyOS are coming.

catch_visual.intent: the Android-only limit and what remote mode leaves out

Split plate: the phone with a one-tap local/remote switch on top, and below it a step list of what the engine can touch.
